items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: The (?) had a good piano player, Don Kirkpatrick, who played piano in Chick Webb's band. Eddie Gibbs... He had a good rhythm section. We all linked up together.

ctx.x: Now, was it an easy band to play in? Did everybody get along with one another?

Yeah, they got along fine! The (?) had a good piano player, Don Kirkpatrick, who played piano in Chick Webb's band. Eddie Gibbs... He had a good rhythm section. We all linked up together. Because the front line is down on the level floor, almost on the level floor, and we had a separate stage in back for the rhythm. The rhythm was right there together, man, because we were right next to one another. We were right together. The rhythm was all right. But they let me out because they said they wanted a New Orleans…
So you weren't New Orleans enough for them.
